stateNote: Quickly wipe the towel on the grate of a preheated charcoal grill. Add steaks to the hottest part and cook 1 ½ minutes, then rotate 90° and cook for another 1 ½ minutes. Flip and repeat 1 more time. If flare-ups appear close to meat, spray with Worcestershire sauce. If not, leave alone.

no temperature given; used the middle of grill's typical range
the step names several durations; used the first
